description: AI integrations can create a 'network effect' where one user's access grants the AI tool access to a broader set of shared data.

instances.assertion: AI integrations can create a 'network effect' where one user's access grants the AI tool access to a broader set of shared data.
AI tools can ingest data shared with a user, which may have been shared with others, leading to rapid and insidious data spread.

nodes.text: AI integrations can create a 'network effect' where one user's access grants the AI tool access to a broader set of shared data.
